name: CelebrateStudio
author: gianmarieddu

sections.description:
CelebrateStudio is a WordPress homepage builder designed for celebration websites and narrative-driven landing pages.

Using a guided 12-step wizard, you can create complete one-page websites in minutes without dealing with complex page-building tools.

Unlike generic page builders, CelebrateStudio provides a predefined storytelling structure that helps organize content into a coherent and engaging narrative.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the celebrate-studio folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open CelebrateStudio from the WordPress dashboard menu.
  4. Create your personal homepage with our 12-step wizard.
sections.faq:
Is it only for weddings?

No. It is optimized for weddings but can be used for any type of landing page.
